_about: Fallback material-density estimates for block identifiers not covered by block-physics.json. Values are in kg/m3. Statuses: verified = checked against a reference; verified_range = selected from a referenced range; unverified_ttr = estimate from the project table without an independently verified source; game_tuned = gameplay tuning, not a physical density. See docs/BLOCK_PHYSICS.md for the distinction between game values and estimates.

air.source: standard air density at sea level (TZ; matches the commonly accepted value)

water.source: TZ; commonly accepted value for fresh water at 4 °C

stone.source: granite: Engineering ToolBox, via smart-calculators.net (2600–2800) and superglobalcalculator.com (2640–2760); the TZ gave 2515–2650 — the lower bound from the TZ is not confirmed, the reference midpoint is used

dirt.source: TZ (1220–1750); no reference found, midpoint of the range

oak_planks.source: oak: Engineering ToolBox via smart-calculators.net (600–900, midpoint 750)

spruce_planks.source: reference point from the Engineering ToolBox wood species list (pine/spruce 350–600), not an exact value

gold_block.source: densitiestable.com: Gold 19300; NIST via smart-calculators.net (19.32 g/cm3)

obsidian.source: superglobalcalculator.com (2350–2550); the TZ gave 2550, midpoint used

emerald_block.source: TZ; no reference found (emerald is beryl, about 2700)

lava.source: TZ gave 3100; reference for molten basalt lava gives 2700–2800 — the value 3100 needs verification

bedrock.source: TZ; not a physical density. Tuned to the game's gravity, as specified in the TZ. The value must be confirmed separately.
